objective: R63: split the character roster into Favorites / Owned / Unowned sections, allow favorites only for owned characters, persist favorite order in user_characters.favorite_sort_order, and apply the same sections to preset character pickers.
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds user_characters.favorite_sort_order INTEGER NULL, clears existing favorites on unowned rows, backfills order for existing favorites, and is reflected in SCHEMA.sql, database.types.ts, sql/README.md and sql/tests.
A DB trigger enforces favorites only for owned characters (unowning clears is_favorite and favorite_sort_order) and appends new favorites to the end of the per-user per-game order.
An atomic SECURITY INVOKER RPC reorders favorites for one game under existing RLS; no cross-user writes are possible.
Client tolerates the unapplied migration (42703/PGRST204/PGRST202) by falling back to name order and disabling reordering without breaking the page.
Roster shows Favorites / Owned / Unowned sections; each character appears once; favorite toggle is unavailable for unowned characters.
Favorites can be reordered by drag and by keyboard-accessible move buttons; order persists after reload.
Preset editor dialog and desktop preset workspace character pickers use the same three sections and favorite order.
tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, git diff --check and the full Vitest suite pass.
